title: 3.3 Double Rotations (LR / RL)
objective: First identify the zig-zag case ([LR] or [RL]), then click the child pivot first and the root pivot second to execute both rotations!
controls: Step 1: Pick [LR (1)] or [RL (2)] -> Step 2: Click child pivot -> Step 3: Click root pivot
start_status: Puzzle 1/2: Inspect the BF badges and identify the double-rotation case: [Case: LR (1)] or [Case: RL (2)]!
hints: Check the root's BF and its heavy child's BF: opposite signs (+2 with -1 = LR; -2 with +1 = RL) mean a zig-zag.
Once the zig-zag case is identified, click the heavy child pivot first to straighten the chain, then click the root pivot.
